content.text: If you purchase a product or register for an account through one of the links on our site, we may receive compensation. Learn more > It's a World Baseball Classic year — meaning baseball fans will get two weeks full of competitive action, featuring some of the sport's biggest stars, in the month of March prior to MLB's Opening Day.Pool play officially opens on March 4, with 20 international teams eyeing a tournament title. The top-two finishers from each of the five-team pools will advance to the quarterfinals for a single-elimination bracket.WATCH: Stream the 2026 World Baseball Classic live through Fubo (free trial)Japan is the defending WBC champion, having taken down the United States in the 2023 Finals, but a star-studded American team enters as the 2026 favorite — while the Dominican Republic, Japan and Venezuela represent a few more top contenders.Here's a look at the full 2026 World Baseball Classic schedule, along with the bracket and updated results throughout the tournament.WORLD BASEBALL
